The sum and constant multiple rules for double summations state that

∑i=1m∑j=1n(aij+bij)=∑i=1m∑j=1naij+∑i=1m∑j=1nbij,∑i=1m∑j=1nkaij=k∑i=1m∑j=1naij.

Applying the sum rule to the given double summation, we have

∑i=18∑j=110(1+aij+2bij)=∑i=18∑j=1101+∑i=18∑j=110aij+∑i=18∑j=1102bij=(∑i=18∑j=1101)+∑i=18∑j=110aij+2∑i=18∑j=110bij=(∑i=18∑j=1101)+25+40=(∑i=18∑j=1101)+65.

Now, using the fact that

∑i=1m∑j=1n1=mn,

we have

(∑i=18∑j=1101)+65=8⋅10+65=80+65=145.

So, we conclude that

∑i=18∑j=110(1+aij+2bij)=145.
